hypothesis: The relationship between leakage-safe pre-match O0 signals and win probability is temporally non-stationary; a restrained time-varying logistic mapping may improve probability quality without discarding historical information through arbitrary decay.

evidence.o6: component outcome-separation declines materially between early and late chronological halves
evidence.o7: targeted fixed 20-match decay rejected for primary test/rolling-origin stability
evidence.o12: strength-by-history interaction rejected on untouched probability-quality metrics

controlled_change.time_variable: training-anchored chronological position t = (row_index - first_train_index) / (last_train_index - first_train_index); future rows may extrapolate above 1
controlled_change.augmentation: for each O0 feature x_j, add x_j * t
controlled_change.time_interactions: one linear temporal interaction per O0 feature
controlled_change.regularization: the same estimator penalty applies to main effects and temporal interactions; no extra penalty multiplier or hyperparameter search is introduced

execution_rules: O0 remains frozen as the control
all O13 features must be computable before the current match
current-match outcome and innings are unavailable to features
time anchor is derived from training chronology only
calibration is validation-only using the canonical raw/Platt/isotonic selector
no new hyperparameter search is permitted
do not tune O13 after observing test or future-holdout results

evaluation_protocol.primary: same chronological O0 split: train 0:1708, validation 1708:2074, untouched test 2074:2440
evaluation_protocol.calibration: validation-only; canonical 5-fold OOF raw/Platt/isotonic selection by log loss, then Brier, then ECE
evaluation_protocol.robustness: same five expanding-origin folds used by O7
evaluation_protocol.promotion_rule: O13 may only replace O0 if it demonstrates a defensible improvement on the untouched test without unacceptable degradation in rolling-origin or future-holdout probability quality. Otherwise reject and retain O0.

non_goals: No O14 proposal before the O13 decision is complete
